title: New York woman fights neighbours over ownership of land strip she maintained for 29 years
summary_full: Lauren Sullivan, a resident of New York, has initiated a legal battle over a slender strip of land she maintains between her home and her neighbors'. Having cared for this space for almost three decades, Sullivan's lawsuit proceeds after the court denied a dismissal request. Her neighbors, Lisa and John Walts, challenge her claim, stating her long-term maintenance isn't sufficient under the law.
